reviews.text: An excellent welcome, very good advice, always a pleasure to visit the shop.
Very nice

Great little shop, very well stocked. I wanted to set up an aquarium and we found everything we needed there, plus all the helpful advice to avoid mistakes. The owner is passionate and very friendly. Can't wait to come back and get my new fish! 🐟 …
The small, much-anticipated group has rejoined its bin of "buddies"... Thank you Animarium

Our visit, with my partner, in 2015 changed our lives. Today we mourn the loss of our rabbit, who brightened our lives for ten and a half years. We can never thank the shop enough for their advice and especially for introducing us to our Patounette, our baby. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts; no words can ever describe what we experienced. Thank you ❤️
Fantastic, and all the animals too. The owner has incredible knowledge, well done and thank you.

I bought a rabbit today; the seller was super friendly, it's always a pleasure to support small businesses, especially in places like this! I'll definitely be back in a few years to buy a companion for my rabbit!
I've been going to this pet shop for over four years now, and I'm always warmly welcomed by Pierre. He gives honest and passionate advice. You can go there with your eyes closed!
I thank the store manager for his kindness, his attentiveness, and all his helpful advice. Nemo and Belle are overjoyed.

The manager is very welcoming and offers great advice. He takes the time to explain everything, which is excellent.
You can tell he's passionate about it.

We were very disappointed. I bought an aquarium, equipment, and fish from this store. I followed the advice given to me by a salesperson to the letter. However, all the fish died after two days. I feel I was given poor advice regarding the necessary products and the acclimation of the fish. I hope the store will take this feedback into account to prevent this from happening to other customers.
Very nice pet shop
The seller was incredibly friendly and knowledgeable; he helped me set up my first aquarium. I highly recommend him; my little sushi is thrilled, and I'll definitely be back.
Very warm welcome, excellent advice, many varieties for fish and birds

He's a really kind gentleman, and on top of that, he's always there to advise you, even if you have a problem with your fish. He knows what he's doing. He's always smiling and gives excellent advice. I trust him completely.
Very good advice

The salesperson was knowledgeable, offered excellent advice, and was very helpful! You can see the aquariums with fish, shrimp, and snails 😊 A good selection of aquatic plants and aquarium supplies! …
Excellent welcome, attentive to the customer, good quality fish. This is my second time there, I recommend it, the prices are not excessive.

Having visited this pet shop before, I can say the welcome was warm, the gentleman was kind and knowledgeable, and he gave me some great advice.

I bought a red betta and I'm very happy with it ☺️
Very friendly and competent manager

A very nice pet shop with attractive prices. The owner is very friendly and takes the time to advise customers.

We bought our first aquarium (and our first fish). My first visit was alone to buy the equipment and get all the information I needed, and my second visit (a bit noisier) a week later with my children to choose the fish. Each time, the welcome was warm. I highly recommend it.
Top-notch seller, a true enthusiast with excellent advice!!!
Really very good, welcoming and professional.

So, I've finally found the perfect person for my aquarium pond... They give great advice on how to get started and maintain it properly. From plants to sand and your first fish, they provide excellent information and guidance. Plus, the owner is super friendly and doesn't push you to buy anything. It's definitely my go-to shop now.
The salesperson was very kind. He took the time to serve us and give us good advice. It was much appreciated. A big thank you to him, I highly recommend him!

Why do pet stores wait for a law to make ethical and sensible decisions?

Twenty or so screaming birds in a ridiculous cage, a fish bigger than the aquarium in a box.
Aren't you ashamed? Dogs and cats have been banned from being sold in pet stores; have some pity on the remains of the animals.
I won't set foot in there again, and I urge others to do the same as long as this continues.
I want to be able to look at myself in the mirror in the morning.

I keep coming back to this great pet shop for my canaries. The owner is very professional and kind. I've known him for a long time because I bought some fish for my son for his 5th birthday... he's 23 now... and he kept them for a very long time.
